xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4560: Profile dashboard re-renders under live event load and fix the top offenders

plan.title: Profile dashboard re-renders under live event load and fix the top offenders
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: About 37 files across 6 subsystems. Eight of those files are the new render-count harness and its seven tests, which AC #4 requires per fixed path; six more are existing tests that must keep passing. ACs #1-#3 are measured by one profiling harness in one baseline/after run, so splitting the streaming path into a sibling issue would duplicate the profiling runs and split the operator-written acceptance list. Each item is a separate commit with its own test.

narratives.Problem: Nobody has measured dashboard re-renders under live events. A static census found structural causes on the Command Deck route: runtime events rewrite agentsById to bump an unread field (event-reducers.ts bumpRuntimeSnapshotSequence) at least twice per tool call; selectBackendPanes builds a fresh array, so every issue row re-renders on every store set (via useIssueActions in FeatureItem); useIssueActions, App and CommandDeck subscribe to whole agent and issue slices, so one change re-renders the whole tree; IssueMissionControl subscribes to every agent; a streamed delta re-renders ComposerFooter; a conversation-list poll re-renders every row.
narratives.Proposal: Add a render-count test harness and a repeatable profiling tool (react-dom/profiling build, bippy probe, Playwright scenarios against the live dashboard on port 3010 with in-page synthetic load). Post a baseline table. Fix the offenders with narrow selectors, identity-keeping selectors and reducers, call-time getState() reads in handlers, a leaf host for App's live-store subscriptions, a memoized ComposerFooter with stable props, and a memoized ConversationListItem. Guard each path with a render-count test, document the rules in docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md, post the after table and file one follow-up issue for the rest.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No shared clock for relative-time labels and no removal of App's 5 s backend-health poll re-render (follow-up issue)
- No identity preservation for equal-data agent.enrichment_changed, agent.status_changed or syncSnapshot (follow-up issue)
- No timeline row reuse in deriveMessagesTimelineRows and no change to the composer's duplicate text state (follow-up issue)
- No fixes on the Kanban, Pipeline, GodView, Live Agents or Home pages (follow-up issue)
- No React 19 upgrade and no React Compiler (PAN-4561)
- No edits to the OKF knowledge bundle
- No server-side event-emission changes
- No user-visible behavior or visual changes
- The profiling tool must never send a mutating request to the dashboard server
- No allowlist raise in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt

autoDecisions.summary: Scope the outcome guarantees (AC #2, #3) to the Command Deck route: App shell, CommandDeck, project tree rows, conversation list, Stage and cockpit.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names the Command Deck, the sidebar and the open timeline; other pages have their own page-level aggregators and go to the follow-up issue, which keeps this plan reviewable.

autoDecisions.summary: Aggregate chrome (pills, nav Sidebar, ConversationDock) is exempt from 'only the rows that show that issue or agent'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Those surfaces display cross-issue totals; render-count tests assert on an explicit non-aggregate set, so review has a mechanical target.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep App's 5 s backend-health poll re-render; defer the shared clock for relative-time labels and the ticker fixes to the follow-up issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: Several labels advance only because of that re-render; removing it without a shared-clock sweep (~15 files) would freeze them, violating NFR-1. The ticker scenario is still profiled here as AC #1 requires.

autoDecisions.summary: Profile against the live dashboard through vite preview on port 3010, with synthetic in-page events and stream deltas for determinism.
autoDecisions.rationale: Port 3010 is already a trusted origin (origin-validation.ts getTrustedOrigins), the live snapshot is the realistic load the issue asks for, and in-page synthetic events never reach the server (NFR-5).

autoDecisions.summary: Use bippy@0.7.3 (exact pin) injected by Playwright addInitScript, plus a react-dom/profiling alias with minify:false, instead of wrapping app components in <Profiler>.
autoDecisions.rationale: It gives per-component names and selfBaseDuration in a production build without touching app components; React DevTools cannot be driven headlessly.

autoDecisions.summary: Document the rules in docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md rather than the OKF frontend/state-management concept.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows either; the OKF bundle is a separate repository outside this PR's review.

autoDecisions.summary: Allow manual memo/useMemo/useCallback only where a render-count test proves the need (ComposerFooter, ConversationListItem, the composer prop hook, useConversationMutations); prefer structural fixes.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4561 will remove manual memoization under the React Compiler; behavior-level render-count tests are the safety net for that removal.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the issue whole and set sizeJustification (about 37 files) rather than splitting the streaming path into a sibling issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: ACs #1-#3 are measured by one harness in one baseline/after run, and AC #4 requires a test per fixed path; splitting would duplicate the profiling runs and split the operator's acceptance list.

autoDecisions.summary: Remove the runtimeSnapshotSequence schema field together with the reducer bump.
autoDecisions.rationale: git grep shows no reader; leaving an optional schema field that nothing writes would be an orphan created by this change.

items.title: Add the render-count test harness (renderCounter.tsx)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/test-utils/renderCounter.tsx exporting createRenderCounter() -> { Probe, count, counts, reset } (Probe wraps children in React <Profiler> and counts onRender calls whose phase !== 'mount'), applyStoreEvents(events) (act(() => useDashboardStore.getState().applyEvents(events))), resetDashboardStore() (setState(initialCapturedAtModuleLoad, true)) and seedDashboardStore(partial). Header comment states that tests assert render counts, never memo usage. Use the exact snippet in the PRD.

items.title: Given a Probe-wrapped child that re-renders twice after mount, when count(id) is read, then it returns 2 and excludes the mount commit

Given seedDashboardStore was called in a test, when resetDashboardStore() runs, then useDashboardStore.getState() returns the initial state with every action function (applyEvents, openIssue) still callable
Given an array of DomainEvents, when applyStoreEvents(events) is called, then the store applies them inside act() so React flushes the resulting renders before the call returns
Add the profiling build mode, bippy probe and Playwright scenario driver

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. vite.config.ts becomes defineConfig(({ mode }) => ...) with a 'profile' mode that aliases /^react-dom$/ to react-dom/profiling and builds to ../../../.tmp/dashboard-profile with minify:false (never the normal dist/dashboard/public outDir). Frontend package.json gains devDependency bippy@0.7.3 (exact) plus scripts build:profile ('vite build --mode profile') and preview:profile ('vite preview --mode profile --port 3010 --strictPort'); run bun install so bun.lock updates. main.tsx exposes window.__overdeckQueryClient only when import.meta.env.MODE === 'profile'. tests/profiling/render-probe.ts uses bippy instrument/traverseRenderedFibers/isCompositeFiber/getDisplayName to record per-component updates, mounts and fiber.selfBaseDuration, exposed as window.__renderProbe { begin, end }. tests/profiling/render-profile.spec.ts bundles the probe to an IIFE with Vite's build() JS API, injects it with addInitScript, and drives the four scenarios (S1 synthetic stream deltas via setQueryData, S2 synthetic event batches via applyEvents with sequence = current state.sequence, S3 composer typing without Enter, S4 65 s idle), writing .tmp/pan-4560-profile/<label>.json and .md. It never clicks a mutating control. Follow the implementation checkpoint in the PRD (react-dom/client alias fallback; stop and pan tell if the preview origin is rejected).
